entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand tracker. It's useless and I want my money back immediately.
I can certainly look into a return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There is no issue! I just **don't use it**. It was a total **impulse buy** and I **changed my mind**. This isn't complicated. Are you going to process my return or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand completely, sir. No need for a manager, I can handle this for you. I just need to pull up your order details. Can I get your name and order number?
The name is Sam Jones. The order number is... VF789012. I got it about two or three weeks ago. Now hurry up, I don't have all day.
Thank you, Mr. Jones. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It looks like it was delivered 18 days ago. Let me just quickly confirm the return eligibility for you.
What is there to confirm?! This is unbelievable! If you don't give me my money back right now, I'm going to blast VeloFit on every social media and review site on the internet. This is a scam!
Sir, I do apologize for the wait. And good news, I've just checked the policy. You are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh. You're serious? So you're actually going to do it then?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending the prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days.
Finally. Okay. That's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mr. Jones. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
